title: Emerald Mod
description: This mod adds new emerald items and elements to the game
body:
### **The Mod**
This mod adds new tools, armor, villager trades and much more. Now u can craft emerald tools and armor. Explore word what has more use to emerald. New building blocks (emerald stairs, slabs, doors, buttons and walls. and buildings  Next i am going add so emerald spawnin caves often and emerald mace, shields, redtone stuff, armors, tools, buildings. U should download this mod because it changes fully how emeralds work in minecraft and more use to emeralds. Two new buildings added 1. Emerald Temple has loot inside. Generates in Emerald Biome. 2. Emerald beacon building spawns in Emerald Biome. Has chest where is Beacon and other stuff. Biome has emerald block layer, emerald ore layer and stone layer. biome has new buildings and loot inside. Biome has creepy sounds, green water and emerald trees. Adds new dimension, trees, ores, ingots.

![Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cdcf8b0c43daf675712f6ff6c463660f0ebb81c7_0.webp)

### **Download Guide**
1: Go to downloads and choose version.

2: U need have neoforge, minecraft version (21.8).

3: Download the file.

4: Open mods folder on neoforge in minecraft launcher.

5: Drag the mod file in the mod folder.

6: Launch the game.
